name: Import-to-frame theorem
statement: Uniform Main+Err over all coefficient vectors implies G_{q,w} >= (1-eps)c H_N

name: Residual coupling theorem
statement: G_{q,w} >= gamma H_N and R^*H_NR >= cG_R imply R^*G_{q,w}R >= gamma c G_R

name: Unweighted character theorem
statement: For prime q and L<q, complete characters give (q-1)I

name: Fluctuation theorem
statement: Weighted frame survives if fluctuation norm is smaller than uniform main term

name: No scalar overread
statement: One mollifier lower bound does not imply matrix lower frame
